import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/work")
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, Point, offset
from blocklib import held_block, ground_blocks, show, HALF_H

ARM = "right"
B = (0.00, -0.15)          # chosen stack base location (world x,y)
TABLE_Z = 0.7655           # measured support height of the resting blocks
GAP = 0.002                # clearance above the support when releasing
TOL_M = 0.010

obs = current()
tcp = np.array(obs.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
center, info = held_block(ARM, "right_wrist")
print("held:", info)
if center is None:
    handoff("cannot measure held block", info=info)

# table height check at B
gq = tools.geometry_query(camera="head", world_points_m=[[B[0], B[1], TABLE_Z]])
wp = gq["result"]["world_points"][0]
print("table check at B:", json.dumps({k: wp.get(k) for k in ["scene_depth_m", "depth_residual_m", "pixel_uv_rounded"]}))
table_z = TABLE_Z
if wp.get("scene_depth_m") is not None:
    # scene depth along that ray; convert: use residual to see whether point lies on the surface
    pass

desired = np.array([B[0], B[1], table_z + HALF_H + GAP])
tcp_target = desired - (center - tcp)
print("desired center", np.round(desired,4).tolist(), "tcp target", np.round(tcp_target,4).tolist())

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(tcp_target, "world"), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
print("move status", r.status, "ok", r.ok, "failure", r.failure_code, "err_m", r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("place move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)

# re-measure TCP, verify arrival
obs2 = current()
tcp_now = np.array(obs2.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
miss = float(np.linalg.norm(tcp_now - tcp_target))
print("tcp after move", np.round(tcp_now,4).tolist(), "miss_m", round(miss,4))
if miss > 0.015:
    handoff("gripper missed placement pose", miss=miss, target=np.round(tcp_target,4).tolist())

g = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"})
print("release", g.status, g.ok, g.failure_code)

obs3 = current()
tcp_now = np.array(obs3.pose(ARM).xyz, float)
up = tcp_now + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.10])
r2 = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(up, "world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("retreat", r2.status, r2.ok, r2.target_error_m)

blocks = ground_blocks()
show(blocks)
json.dump({"B": B, "table_z": table_z}, open("/work/state.json","w"))

sys.path.insert(0, "/work")
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, Point
from blocklib import held_block, ground_blocks, show, HALF_H

ARM = "right"
GAP = 0.002
B = (0.00, -0.15)
YELLOW_OLD = (0.3636, -0.1509)   # last measured (observation-0000) position of the tan block

obs = current()
print("tcp before", np.round(obs.pose(ARM).xyz,4).tolist())

# move the right arm up out of the head camera's line of sight to the tan block (free space, 0.2 m clear)
above = np.array([YELLOW_OLD[0], YELLOW_OLD[1], 1.06])
r0 = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(above, "world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("pre-move", r0.status, r0.ok, r0.target_error_m)
if not r0.ok:
    handoff("pre-move failed", status=r0.status, failure=r0.failure_code, summary=r0.summary)

def find_tan(blocks):
    return [b for b in blocks if b["bbox"][3] < 380 and b["label"] == "tan"]

blocks = ground_blocks()
show(blocks)
tan = find_tan(blocks)
cam_used = "head"
if len(tan) != 1:
    blocks_w = ground_blocks(camera="right_wrist", text="block")
    show(blocks_w)
    tan = [b for b in blocks_w if b["label"] == "tan"]
    cam_used = "right_wrist"
if len(tan) != 1:
    handoff("tan block not uniquely identified", head=[(b['candidate_id'],b['label'],b['bbox']) for b in blocks],
            wrist=[(b['candidate_id'],b['label'],b['bbox']) for b in blocks_w])
tb = tan[0]
print("tan from", cam_used, "center", np.round(tb["center"],4).tolist())

base = [b for b in blocks if b["bbox"][3] < 380 and b["label"] == "dark"]
if len(base) != 1:
    handoff("base not found", labels=[(b['candidate_id'],b['label']) for b in blocks])
base_top = float(base[0]["center"][2]) + 0.001
print("base top", round(base_top,4))

p = tools.grasp_plan(arm=ARM, target_ref=tb["target_ref"], max_candidates=3)
print("grasp_plan", p.status, p.ok, p.failure_code, p.summary)
if not p.ok:
    handoff("grasp_plan failed", status=p.status, failure=p.failure_code, summary=p.summary)
cands = [c for c in p["result"]["candidates"] if c.get("ik_reachability",{}).get("reachable")]
if not cands:
    handoff("no reachable grasp candidate for tan", n=len(p["result"]["candidates"]))
cand = sorted(cands, key=lambda c: c.get("rank", 99))[0]
print("grasp candidate", cand["candidate_id"], cand["contact_pose"]["position_m"])
ex = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=cand["candidate_id"], rationale="pick the tan block to stack on the dark base")
print("grasp", ex.status, ex.ok, ex.failure_code, ex.summary)
if not ex.ok:
    handoff("grasp_execute failed", status=ex.status, failure=ex.failure_code, summary=ex.summary,
            stages=ex["result"].get("stages"))

tcp = np.array(current().pose(ARM).xyz, float)
center, info = held_block(ARM, "right_wrist")
print("held:", info)
if center is None:
    handoff("cannot measure held tan block", info=info)
desired = np.array([B[0], B[1], base_top + HALF_H + GAP])
tcp_target = desired - (center - tcp)
print("desired", np.round(desired,4).tolist(), "tcp target", np.round(tcp_target,4).tolist())

r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(tcp_target, "world"), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
print("place", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("place move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
tcp_now = np.array(current().pose(ARM).xyz, float)
miss = float(np.linalg.norm(tcp_now - tcp_target))
print("miss", round(miss,4))
if miss > 0.015:
    handoff("missed placement pose", miss=miss)
g = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"})
print("release", g.status, g.ok)
tcp_now = np.array(current().pose(ARM).xyz, float)
r2 = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(tcp_now + np.array([0.0,0.0,0.12]), "world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("retreat", r2.status, r2.ok, r2.target_error_m)
show(ground_blocks())

import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff, target
from ora_lib import current, Point

# 1. park the right arm away from the stack

blocks = ground_blocks()
show(blocks)
tb = [b for b in blocks if b["bbox"][3] < 380]
white = [b for b in tb if b["label"] == "white"]
stack = [b for b in tb if b["label"] in ("tan","dark")]
print("white", [b["candidate_id"] for b in white], "stack", [(b["candidate_id"], b["label"]) for b in stack])
if len(white) != 1 or len(stack) != 1:
    handoff("blocks not uniquely identified for step 4", labels=[(b['candidate_id'],b['label'],b['bbox']) for b in blocks])
top_prev = float(stack[0]["center"][2]) + 0.002   # surface centroid -> top face plane

    handoff("no reachable left grasp candidate", n=len(p["result"]["candidates"]))
cand = sorted(cands, key=lambda c: c.get("rank", 99))[0]
ex = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=cand["candidate_id"], rationale="pick the white block to place on top of the stack")

if not ex.ok:
    handoff("left grasp_execute failed", status=ex.status, failure=ex.failure_code, summary=ex.summary)

# 4. measure held block, compute placement
tcp = np.array(current().pose("left").xyz, float)
center, info = held_block("left", "left_wrist")
print("held:", info)
if center is None:
    handoff("cannot measure held white block", info=info)
desired = np.array([B[0], B[1], top_prev + HALF_H + GAP])
tcp_target = desired - (center - tcp)
print("desired", np.round(desired,4).tolist(), "tcp target", np.round(tcp_target,4).tolist())

r = tools.move_pose(targets={"left": target(Point(tcp_target, "world"), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
print("place", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if not r.ok:
    handoff("left place move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
tcp_now = np.array(current().pose("left").xyz, float)
miss = float(np.linalg.norm(tcp_now - tcp_target))
print("miss", round(miss,4))
if miss > 0.015:
    handoff("left missed placement pose", miss=miss)
g = tools.set_gripper(targets={"left": "open"})
print("release", g.status, g.ok)
tcp_now = np.array(current().pose("left").xyz, float)
r2 = tools.move_pose(targets={"left": target(Point(tcp_now + np.array([0.0,0.0,0.12]), "world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("retreat", r2.status, r2.ok, r2.target_error_m)
show(ground_blocks())

import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/work")
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
from blocklib import ground_blocks, show

obs = current()
cam = obs.camera("head")
K = np.array(cam.K, float); C2W = np.array(cam.camera_to_world, float)
depth = np.asarray(cam.depth_m, float); H, W = depth.shape
u, v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(W), np.arange(H)); z = depth
valid = np.isfinite(z) & (z > 0.2) & (z < 1.2)
fx, fy, cx, cy = K[0,0], K[1,1], K[0,2], K[1,2]
pc = np.stack([(u-cx)/fx*z, (v-cy)/fy*z, z], axis=-1)
pw = pc @ C2W[:3,:3].T + C2W[:3,3]
sel = valid & (np.abs(pw[:,:,0]) < 0.06) & (pw[:,:,1] > -0.25) & (pw[:,:,1] < -0.05) & (pw[:,:,2] > 0.77) & (pw[:,:,2] < 0.88)
p = pw[sel]
print("stack points", p.shape)
bands = {"base_dark": (0.770, 0.792), "mid_tan": (0.800, 0.822), "top_white": (0.830, 0.852)}
res = {}
for name, (z0, z1) in bands.items():
    q = p[(p[:,2] > z0) & (p[:,2] < z1)]
    if len(q) < 30:
        print(name, "too few", len(q)); continue
    res[name] = {
        "n": len(q),
        "y_min": round(float(np.percentile(q[:,1], 2)), 4),
        "x_center": round(float(0.5*(np.percentile(q[:,0],2)+np.percentile(q[:,0],98))), 4),
